entries.66.1: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, याम् एव on that very, रात्रिम् night, पर्णशालाम् the leaf-hut, उपाविशत् entered, ताम् एव on that very, रात्रिम् night, सीता अपि Sita too, दारकद्वयम् a pair of boys, प्रसूता brought forth
entries.66.2: ततः then, अर्धरात्रसमये at the hour of midnight, बालकाः the boys, मुनिदारकाः children of the hermitage, वाल्मीकेः to Valmiki, सीतायाः of Sita, शुभम् the auspicious, प्रसवम् delivery, प्रियम् as glad news, आचख्युः announced
entries.66.3: भगवन् O venerable one, सा she, रामपत्नी the wife of Rama, दारकद्वयम् a pair of boys, प्रसूता has borne, महातेजः O you of great splendour, ततः therefore, भूतविनाशिनीम् that destroys evil spirits, रक्षाम् a rite of protection, कुरु perform
entries.66.4: महर्षिः the great sage, तेषाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, समुपागमत् came, बालचन्द्रप्रतीकाशौ resembling the young moon, देवपुत्रौ like sons of the gods, महौजसौ of great might
entries.66.5: हृष्टात्मा glad at heart, तत्र thither, जगाम went, कुमारकौ the two little boys, ददर्श च and saw, ताभ्याम् for those two, भूतघ्नीम् that slays evil spirits, रक्षोविनाशिनीम् that destroys rakshasas, रक्षाम् the rite of protection, अकरोत् performed
entries.66.6: सः that, द्विजः brahmin, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, कुशमुष्टिम् a handful of kusha grass, लवं चैव तु and a blade of lava grass, उपादाय having taken, ताभ्याम् to those two, भूतविनाशिनीम् that destroys evil spirits, रक्षाम् the protection, प्रददौ gave
entries.66.7: तयोः of those two, यः who, पूर्वजः the elder, जातः was born, सः he, मन्त्रसत्कृतैः hallowed with mantras, कुशैः with kusha blades, तदा then, निर्मार्जनीयः तु was to be wiped clean, कुश इति as Kusha, अस्य his, तत् that, नाम is the name
entries.66.8: ताभ्याम् of those two, यश्च and whoever, अवरः the younger, भवेत् should be, सः he, लवेन with a blade of lava grass, समाहितः duly, वृद्धाभिः by the elder women, निर्मार्जनीयः to be wiped clean, नामतः by name, लव इति एव as Lava indeed
entries.66.9: एवम् thus, तौ those two, उभौ both, यमजातकौ twin-born, नाम्ना by name, कुशलवौ Kusha and Lava, मत्कृताभ्याम् given by me, नामभ्याम् by these names, ख्यातियुक्तौ renowned, भविष्यतः shall become
entries.66.10: ताः they, समाहिताः with due care, मुनिहस्तात् from the hand of the sage, ताम् that, रक्षाम् rite of protection, जगृहुः received, ततः then, विगतकल्मषाः their impurities gone, तयोः for those two, रक्षाम् the rite of protection, अकुर्वन् च and performed
entries.66.11: तथा so, वृद्धाभिः by the elder women, क्रियमाणाम् being performed, ताम् that, जन्म the birth, नाम च and the naming, रामस्य of Rama, सङ्कीर्तनं च and the celebration, सीतायाः of Sita, शुभौ auspicious, प्रसवौ the two births
entries.66.12: अर्धरात्रे तु and at midnight, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, सुमहत् exceedingly great, प्रियम् glad news, शुश्राव heard, ततः then, पर्णशालाम् to the leaf-hut, गत्वा having gone, मातः O mother, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, इति thus, अब्रवीत् च and said
entries.66.13: तथा so, प्रहृष्टस्य of him rejoicing, महात्मनः the great-souled, लघुविक्रमः swift of stride, तस्य his, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, वार्षिकी of the rains, श्रावणी of the month of Shravana, रात्रिः night, व्यतीता passed away
entries.66.14: सुमहावीर्यः of exceedingly great might, प्रभाते at dawn, पौर्वाह्णिकीम् the morning, क्रियाम् rite, कृत्वा having performed, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, मुनिम् the sage, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of, पुनः again, पश्चान्मुखः facing westward, ययौ went
entries.66.15: सः he, यमुनातीरम् to the bank of the Yamuna, गत्वा having gone, पथि on the road, सप्तरात्रोषितः having lodged seven nights, पुण्यकीर्तीनाम् of holy renown, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासम् his lodging, अभ्ययात् took
entries.66.16: महायशाः of great renown, सः that, नृपः king, तत्र there, भार्गवप्रमुखैः headed by Bhargava, मुनिभिः सार्धम् together with the sages, अभिरूपाभिः with becoming, कथाभिः talk, वासम् his stay, चक्रे passed
entries.66.17: महात्मा the great-souled one, नरेन्द्रसूनुः son of the lord of men, रघुप्रवीरः foremost hero of the Raghus, सः he, काञ्चनाद्यैः headed by Kanchana, मुनिभिः with the sages, समेतः gathered, तदानीम् then, बहुभिः with many, कथाप्रकारैः kinds of story, रजनीम् the night, विरामयामास brought to a close
entries.67.1: अथ then, रात्र्याम् when the night, प्रवृत्तायाम् had set in, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भृगुनन्दनम् the delight of the Bhrigus, विप्रम् the brahmin, च्यवनम् Chyavana, लवणस्य of Lavana, बलम् the strength, यथा how great it was, पप्रच्छ asked
entries.67.2: ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, शूलस्य of the trident, बलं च and the power, अनेन by this, शूलमुख्येन foremost of tridents, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् single combat, उपागताः having come to, के who, पूर्वम् formerly, विनाशिताः were destroyed
entries.67.3: महातेजाः of great splendour, च्यवनः Chyavana, महात्मनः of the great-souled, तस्य his, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, रघुनन्दनम् to the delight of the Raghus, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.67.4: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, अस्य his, यानि which, कर्माणि deeds, असङ्ख्येयानि are past counting, इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवे in one born of the Ikshvaku line, यत् what, वृत्तम् came to pass, तत् that, मे from me, शृणुष्व hear
entries.67.5: पुरा of old, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, बली the mighty, युवनाश्वसुतः son of Yuvanashva, वीर्यवान् the valorous, राजा king, सः he, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु worlds, मान्धाता इति as Mandhata, विख्यातः was renowned
entries.67.6: पृथिवीपतिः the lord of the earth, सः that, नृपः king, कृत्स्नाम् the whole, पृथिवीम् earth, शासने under his rule, कृत्वा having brought, इतः from here, सुरलोकम् the world of the gods, जेतुम् to conquer, उद्योगम् an effort, अकरोत् made
entries.67.7: मान्धातरि when Mandhata, देवलोकजिगीषया out of desire to conquer the world of the gods, कृतोद्योगे had made ready, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, सुराणां च and of the gods, तीव्रम् keen, भयम् was the fear
entries.67.8: पार्थिवः the king, शक्रस्य of Shakra, अर्धासनेन with half the throne, राज्यार्धेन च and half the sovereignty, सुरगणैः by the hosts of gods, वन्द्यमानः being entreated, प्रतिज्ञाम् to his resolve, अध्यरोहत held fast
entries.67.9: पाकशासनः the chastiser of Paka, तस्य his, पापम् evil, अभिप्रायम् purpose, विदित्वा having learnt, युवनाश्वजम् to the son of Yuvanashva, सान्त्वपूर्वम् with conciliatory words, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच spoke
entries.67.10: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, त्वम् you, मानुषे in the world of men, लोके in that world, राजा are king, न तावत् not yet, पृथिवीम् the earth, वश्याम् subject, अकृत्वा without having made, इह here, देवराज्यम् the kingship of the gods, इच्छसि you desire
entries.67.11: वीर O hero, यदि if, समग्रा entire, निखिला whole, मेदिनी the earth, ते your, वशे under sway, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with your servants and troops and mounts, इह here, देवराज्यम् the kingship of the gods, कुरुष्व take
entries.67.12: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, तम् that, इन्द्रम् Indra, मान्धाता Mandhata, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, शक्र O Shakra, पृथिवीतले upon the face of the earth, मे my, शासनम् rule, क्व where, प्रतिहतम् is it withstood
entries.67.13: सहस्राक्षः the thousand-eyed one, तम् him, उवाच answered, अनघ O sinless one, मधुपुत्रः the son of Madhu, लवणो नाम Lavana by name, राक्षसः a rakshasa, मधुवने in the Madhu wood, ते your, आज्ञाम् command, न कुरुते does not obey
entries.67.14: सहस्राक्षेण by the thousand-eyed one, भाषितम् spoken, घोरम् dreadful, विप्रियम् unwelcome word, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा the king, व्रीडितः abashed, अवाङ्मुखः his face bent down, व्याहर्तुम् to utter a word, न शशाक ह was not able
entries.67.15: श्रीमान् the illustrious, नरेश्वरः lord of men, ह्रिया out of shame, किञ्चित् somewhat, अवाङ्मुखः his face bent down, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, आमन्त्र्य तु having taken leave of, पुनः एव once more, इमम् this, लोकम् world, आगमत् came to
entries.67.16: अरिन्दमः the tamer of foes, सः he, हृदये in his heart, अमर्षम् resentment, कृत्वा having kept, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with his servants and troops and mounts, मधोः of Madhu, पुत्रम् the son, वशे under his sway, कर्तुम् to bring, आजगाम came
entries.67.17: पुरुषर्षभः the bull among men, सः he, लवणम् Lavana, युद्धाय for battle, काङ्क्षमाणः desiring, लवणस्य of Lavana, सकाशम् हि to the presence indeed, दूतम् a messenger, सम्प्रेषयामास sent
entries.67.18: सः he, गत्वा having gone, मधुनः of Madhu, सुतम् to the son, बहूनि many, विप्रियाणि galling words, आह spoke, एवम् thus, वदन्तम् as he spoke, तम् that, दूतम् messenger, राक्षसः the rakshasa, भक्षयामास devoured
entries.67.19: दूते तु and when the messenger, चिरायमाणे was long in returning, राजा the king, क्रोधसमन्वितः filled with wrath, समन्ततः on every side, शरवृष्ट्या with a rain of arrows, तत् that, रक्षः rakshasa, अर्दयामास harried
entries.67.20: ततः then, तत् that, रक्षः rakshasa, प्रहस्य having laughed, पाणिना in his hand, शूलम् the trident, जग्राह took up, सानुबन्धस्य of him with all his following, वधाय for the slaying, उत्तमम् that supreme, आयुधम् weapon, मुमोच loosed
entries.67.21: दीप्यमानम् blazing, तत् that, शूलं तु trident indeed, सभृत्यबलवाहनम् with his servants and troops and mounts, नृपम् the king, भस्मीकृत्वा having reduced to ashes, भूयः again, लवणस्य of Lavana, करम् the hand, आगमत् returned to
entries.67.22: एवम् thus, सः that, सुमहान् exceedingly great, राजा king, सबलवाहनः with his troops and mounts, हतः was slain, सौम्य O gentle one, शूलस्य तु and of the trident, बलम् the power, अप्रमेयम् is immeasurable, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed
entries.67.23: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते तु at dawn, अगृहीतायुधम् before he has taken up his weapon, लवणम् Lavana, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, वधिष्यसि you shall slay, न संशयः there is no doubt, तव your, विजयः victory, ध्रुवः हि is certain indeed
entries.67.24: त्वया by you, कर्मणि when the deed, कृते is done, लोकानाम् for the worlds, स्वस्ति चैव welfare too, स्यात् shall be, दुरात्मनः of the evil-souled, लवणस्य Lavana, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, ते to you, आख्यातम् has been told
entries.67.25: नरर्षभ O bull among men, पार्थिव O king, शूलस्य of the trident, घोरम् dreadful, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, बलं च and the power, यत् which, तेन by it, मान्धातुः of Mandhata, विनाशश्चैव and the destruction, अभूत् came about
entries.67.26: महात्मन् O great-souled one, नरेन्द्र O lord of men, त्वम् you, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते at dawn, लवणम् Lavana, वधिष्यसे shall slay, अत्र तु herein, मे to me, संशयः न there is no doubt, आमिषार्थे in quest of flesh, शूलम् his trident, विना without, निर्गतम् having gone forth, ते your, जयः victory, ध्रुवः certain, भविता shall be
entries.68.1: कथाम् their tale, कथयताम् as they told, शुभम् auspicious, जयं च and victory, आकाङ्क्षताम् as they longed for, तेषाम् for them, महात्मनः of the great-souled, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna, रजनी the night, शीघ्रम् swiftly, व्यतीता passed away
entries.68.2: ततः then, विमले in the clear, प्रभाते dawn, तस्मिन् at that, काले hour, सः that, धीरः bold, राक्षसः rakshasa, भक्ष्याहारप्रचोदितः driven by hunger for food, पुरात् from the city, निर्गतः तु went forth
entries.68.3: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in this interval, वीरः the hero, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, यमुनाम् the Yamuna, नदीम् river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, मधुपुरद्वारि at the gate of Madhupura, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, अतिष्ठत took his stand
entries.68.4: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे when half the day, प्राप्ते was come, क्रूरकर्मा of cruel deeds, सः that, राक्षसः rakshasa, प्राणिनाम् of living creatures, बहुसाहस्रम् many thousands, भारम् as a load, उद्वहन् carrying, आगच्छत् came
entries.68.5: ततः then, द्वारि at the gate, धृतायुधम् weapon in hand, स्थितम् standing, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, ददर्श he saw, ततः then, रक्षः the rakshasa, तम् to him, उवाच said, अनेन with this, किम् what, करिष्यसि will you do
entries.68.6: नराधम O basest of men, ईदृशानाम् of such as you, सायुधानाम् armed men, सहस्राणि thousands, रोषात् in my fury, मया by me, भक्षितानि have been devoured, कालम् your hour, नु किम् why then, आकाङ्क्षसे do you court
entries.68.7: पुरुषाधम O vilest of men, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, अस्य of this day, आहारः the meal, सम्पूर्णः is complete, अयम् this, मम is mine, अद्य today, स्वयम् of your own accord, कथम् how is it that, आसाद्य having come, मुखम् my mouth, प्रविष्टः you have entered
entries.68.8: एवम् thus, भाषमाणस्य of him speaking, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, हसतश्च and laughing, तस्य at him, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valour, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, रोषात् out of wrath, अश्रूणि tears, अवासृजत् shed
entries.68.9: रोषाभिभूतस्य of him overcome with wrath, महात्मनः the great-souled, तस्य his, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, तेजोमयाः made of fire, मरीच्यः तु rays indeed, सर्वगात्रैः from all his limbs, विनिष्पतन् poured forth
entries.68.10: सुसङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तम् that, निशाचरम् night-ranger, उवाच च and addressed, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, त्वया सह with you, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् single combat, योद्धुम् to fight, इच्छामि I desire
entries.68.11: अहम् I, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, पुत्रः the son, धीमतः of the wise, रामस्य Rama, भ्राता the brother, नित्यशत्रुघ्नः ever the slayer of foes, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तव your, वधाकाङ्क्षी seeking your death, आगतः have come
entries.68.12: युद्धकामस्य who desires battle, तस्य मे to me, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् single combat, प्रदीयताम् let it be granted, त्वम् you, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, शत्रुः are the enemy, मे from me, जीवन् alive, न गमिष्यसि you shall not go
entries.68.13: तस्मिन् when he, तथा thus, ब्रुवाणे तु was speaking, राक्षसः the rakshasa, प्रहसन् इव as though laughing, नरश्रेष्ठम् to the best of men, प्रत्युवाच replied, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, प्राप्तः असि you have come
entries.68.14: दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, पुरुषाधम O vilest of men, मम my, मातृष्वसुः of my mother's sister, भ्राता the brother, राक्षसाधिपः lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, स्त्रीहेतोः on account of a woman, रामेण by Rama, हतः was slain
entries.68.15: मया by me, रावणस्य of Ravana, कुलक्षयम् the ruin of the house, तच्च that too, सर्वम् entirely, क्षान्तम् has been borne, पुरतः before me, अवज्ञाम् contempt, कृत्वा having shown, मया by me, यूयम् you all, विशेषतः above all
entries.68.16: मे by me, सर्वे all, तृणं यथा like straw, परिभूताः have been slighted, निहताश्च हि and slain indeed, भूताश्चैव those that have been, भविष्याश्च and those to come, यूयं च and you, पुरुषाधमाः basest of men
entries.68.17: दुर्मते O evil-minded one, युद्धकामस्य who desires battle, तस्य ते to you, युद्धम् battle, दास्यामि I shall give, त्वं च and you, मुहूर्तं तु for a moment, तिष्ठ wait, यावत् until, आयुधम् my weapon, आनये I fetch, तुभ्यम् for you, यादृशम् of what kind, ईप्सितम् is desired, यावत् until, आयुधम् the weapon, सज्जये I make ready
entries.68.18: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तम् to him, आशु at once, उवाच said, मे from me, जीवन् alive, क्व whither, गमिष्यसि will you go, कृतात्मना by one of disciplined soul, यदृच्छया by chance, दृष्टः once seen, शत्रुः an enemy, न मोक्तव्यः is not to be let go
entries.68.19: यः who, विक्लवया by a faltering, बुद्ध्या judgement, शत्रवे to his enemy, प्रसरम् free scope, ददौ has given, सः he, मन्दबुद्धित्वात् through dullness of wit, हतः is as good as slain, यथा as, कापुरुषः a coward, तथा so
entries.68.20: तस्मात् therefore, जीवलोकम् the world of the living, सुदृष्टम् well looked upon, कुरु take, शितैः with keen, विविधैः of many kinds, शरैः with shafts, त्रिलोकस्य of the three worlds, राघवस्य च and of Raghava, पापम् the wicked, रिपुम् foe, त्वाम् you, यमस्य of Yama, गेहाभिमुखम् हि toward the house indeed, नयामि I send
entries.69.1: महात्मनः of the great-souled, तस्य his, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, तत् that, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, तीव्रम् fierce, क्रोधम् wrath, आहारयत् he gathered, तिष्ठ तिष्ठ इति stand and stand, अब्रवीत् च and said
entries.69.2: लवणः Lavana, पाणौ upon his palm, पाणिम् his hand, विनिष्पिष्य having struck, दन्तान् his teeth, कटकटाय्य च and having gnashed, रघुशार्दूलम् the tiger of the Raghus, असकृत् repeatedly, आह्वयामास challenged
entries.69.3: देवशत्रुघ्नः slayer of the foes of the gods, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तथा thus, वाक्यम् these words, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, घोरदर्शनम् dreadful to look upon, तम् that, लवणम् Lavana, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.69.4: यथा as, अन्ये others, त्वया by you, निर्जिताः were vanquished, तथा so, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, न जातः has not been born, तत् therefore, अद्य today, बाणाभिहतः struck down by my arrow, त्वम् you, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, व्रज go
entries.69.5: पापात्मन् O evil-souled one, अद्य today, मया by me, रणे in battle, निहतम् slain, त्वाम् you, विद्वांसः learned, विप्राः brahmins, ऋषयः अपि and the sages too, त्रिदशाः the thirty gods, रावणम् इव as they did Ravana, पश्यन्तु let them behold
entries.69.6: निशाचर O night-ranger, मद्बाणनिर्दग्धे when consumed by my shaft, त्वयि you, अद्य today, पतिते have fallen, पुरे in the city, जनपदे चापि and in the country parts, क्षेमम् एव welfare indeed, भविष्यति shall be
entries.69.7: अद्य today, मद्बाहुनिष्क्रान्तः sped from my arm, वज्रनिभाननः its point like the thunderbolt, शरः the shaft, ते your, हृदयम् heart, प्रवेक्ष्यते shall enter, अर्कजः born of the sun, अंशुः इव as a ray does, पद्मम् a lotus
entries.69.8: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with wrath, लवणः Lavana, महावृक्षम् a great tree, शत्रुघ्नोरसि at the breast of Shatrughna, चिक्षेप hurled, सः च and he, तम् it, शतधा into a hundred pieces, अच्छिनत् clove
entries.69.9: तत् that, विफलम् fruitless, कर्म deed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बली the mighty, राक्षसः rakshasa, पुनः एव तु yet again, सुबहून् very many, पादपान् trees, गृह्य having seized, शत्रुघ्नाय at Shatrughna, असृजत् hurled
entries.69.10: तेजस्वी the splendid, शत्रुघ्नश्चापि Shatrughna too, आपततः as they came flying, बहून् many, वृक्षान् trees, नतपर्वभिः with smooth-jointed shafts, त्रिभिः with three, चतुर्भिः with four, एकैकम् each one, चिच्छेद clove asunder
entries.69.11: ततः then, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valour, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, राक्षसोरसि upon the breast of the rakshasa, बाणमयम् of arrows, वर्षम् a rain, व्यसृजत् loosed, सः that, राक्षसः rakshasa, न विव्यथे was not shaken
entries.69.12: ततः then, वीर्यवान् the valorous, लवणः Lavana, प्रहस्य having laughed, वृक्षम् a tree, उद्यम्य having raised, शूरम् the hero, शिरसि upon the head, अभ्यहनत् struck, सः he, स्रस्ताङ्गः his limbs giving way, मुमोह वै swooned away
entries.69.13: तस्मिन् when that, वीरे hero, निपतिते had fallen, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, देवसङ्घानाम् of the hosts of gods, गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् तथा and of gandharvas and apsaras, महान् a great, हाहाकारः cry of woe, अभूत् arose
entries.69.14: तम् him, हतम् slain, भुवि on the ground, पातितम् laid low, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, अवज्ञाय तु having made light of, रक्षः the rakshasa, लब्धान्तरम् अपि though the opening was his, स्वम् his own, आलयम् dwelling, न विवेश did not enter
entries.69.15: तम् him, भुवि on the ground, पातितम् laid low, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शूलम् the trident, न अपि प्रजग्राह neither did he take up, ततः then, हतः इति that he was slain, ज्ञात्वा having concluded, तान् those, भक्षान् his stores of food, समुदावहत् carried off
entries.69.16: मुहूर्तात् after a moment, लब्धसञ्ज्ञः तु and having recovered his senses, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, वै indeed, ऋषिभिः by the sages, सम्प्रपूजितः greatly honoured, पुरद्वारि at the city gate, धृतायुधः weapon in hand, पुनः again, तस्थौ took his stand
entries.69.17: ततः then, दिव्यम् divine, अमोघम् unfailing, तेजसा with splendour, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, घोरम् dreadful, दश the ten, दिशः quarters, पूरयन्तम् filling, तम् that, उत्तमम् supreme, शरम् shaft, जग्राह he took up
entries.69.18: वज्राननम् its point like the thunderbolt, वज्रवेगम् swift as the thunderbolt, मेरुमन्दरसन्निभम् resembling Meru and Mandara, सर्वेषु in all, पर्वसु its joints, नतम् smooth, संयुगेषु in battles, अपराजितम् unvanquished
entries.69.19: असृक्चन्दनदिग्धाङ्गम् its shaft smeared with blood for sandal paste, चारुपत्रम् fair-feathered, पतत्रिणम् the winged one, दानवेन्द्राचलेन्द्राणाम् of lords of danavas and lords of mountains, असुराणां च and of asuras, दारणम् the render
entries.69.20: युगान्ते at the end of an age, समुपस्थिते when it is come, दीप्तम् blazing, कालाग्निम् इव like the fire of time, तम् that, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, परित्रासम् terror, उपागमन् came to
entries.69.21: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वम् with gods and asuras and gandharvas, मुनिभिः with sages, साप्सरोगणम् with hosts of apsaras, सर्वम् the whole, जगत् हि world indeed, अस्वस्थम् ill at ease, पितामहम् the Grandsire, उपस्थितम् approached
entries.69.22: देवदेवेशम् the lord of the lords of gods, वरदम् the giver of boons, प्रपितामहम् the great-grandsire, उवाच it addressed, देवानाम् of the gods, भयसंमोहः the bewilderment of terror, लोकानाम् of the worlds, सङ्क्षयं प्रति touching their destruction
entries.69.23: प्रपितामह O great-grandsire, ईदृशम् such a thing, दृष्टपूर्वं च has never before been seen, न श्रुतम् nor heard of, देवानाम् of the gods, भयसम्मोहः the bewilderment of terror, लोकानाम् of the worlds, सङ्क्षयं प्रति touching their destruction
entries.69.24: लोकपितामहः the Grandsire of the worlds, लोकानाम् of the worlds, अभयङ्करः giver of safety, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तेषाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, भयकारणम् the cause of the terror, आचष्ट declared, मधुराम् a sweet, वाणीम् speech, उवाच spoke, सर्वदेवताः O all you gods, शृणुध्वम् hear
entries.69.25: सुरसत्तमाः O best of the gods, आजौ in the fight, लवणस्य of Lavana, वधाय for the slaying, शत्रुघ्नधारितः held by Shatrughna, शरः the shaft, तस्य its, तेजसा by the splendour, सर्वे all, सम्मूढाः bewildered, स्मः we are
entries.69.26: वत्साः O children, एषः this, पूर्वस्य of the primal, लोककर्तुः maker of the worlds, देवस्य god, सनातनः everlasting, तेजोमयः made of splendour, शरः is the shaft, येन whereby, वै indeed, भयम् the terror, आगतम् has come
entries.69.27: एषः this, वै indeed, महाशरः great shaft, कैटभस्य of Kaitabha, अर्थे for the sake, मधुनश्च and of Madhu, तयोः of those two, दैत्ययोः daityas, वधार्थे for the slaying, तेन by him, महात्मना the great-souled, सृष्टः was fashioned
entries.69.28: विष्णुः Vishnu, एक एव he alone, तेजोमयम् made of splendour, शरम् the shaft, प्रजानाति knows, एषा this, एव indeed, तस्य his, महात्मनः the great-souled, विष्णोः of Vishnu, पूर्वा primal, तनुः is the form
entries.69.29: इतः from here, गच्छत go, महात्मना by the great-souled, वीरेण heroic, रामानुजेन younger brother of Rama, वध्यमानम् being slain, राक्षसोत्तमम् foremost of rakshasas, लवणम् Lavana, पश्यध्वम् behold
entries.69.30: सुराः the gods, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, तस्य his, ते those, वचनम् word, निशम्य having heard, यत्र where, उभौ both, शत्रुघ्नलवणौ Shatrughna and Lavana, युध्येते were fighting, आजग्मुः came
entries.69.31: सर्वभूतानि all beings, शत्रुघ्नकरधारितम् held in the hand of Shatrughna, दिव्यसङ्काशम् of heavenly aspect, युगान्ताग्निम् इव like the fire at the end of an age, उत्थितम् risen, तम् that, शरम् shaft, ददृशुः beheld
entries.69.32: रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, आकाशम् the sky, देवैः हि by the gods indeed, आवृतम् filled, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भृशम् mightily, सिंहनादम् a lion's roar, कृत्वा having made, पुनः again, लक्षणम् his mark, ददर्श took
entries.69.33: महात्मना by the great-souled, तेन by that, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, पुनः again, आहूतश्च and challenged, लवणः Lavana, क्रोधसंयुक्तः filled with wrath, युद्धाय for battle, समुपस्थितः came forward
entries.69.34: धन्विनाम् among bowmen, वरः the best, सः he, अथ then, तत् that, धनुः bow, आकर्णात् to his ear, विकृष्य having drawn, तम् that, महाबाणम् great shaft, लवणस्य of Lavana, महोरसि upon the broad breast, मुमोच loosed
entries.69.35: तस्य his, उरः breast, आशु swiftly, विदार्य having cleft, रसातलम् the nether world, प्रविवेश it entered
entries.69.36: दिव्यः the divine, विबुधपूजितः honoured by the gods, शरः shaft, रसातलम् to the nether world, गत्वा having gone, पुनः एव once again, तूर्णम् swiftly, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् to the delight of the Ikshvaku line, आगमत् returned
entries.69.37: शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नः cleft by the shaft of Shatrughna, सः that, निशाचरः night-ranger, लवणः Lavana, वज्राहतः struck by the thunderbolt, अचलः इव like a mountain, सहसा suddenly, भूमौ to the ground, पपात fell
entries.69.38: तेन by him, लवणराक्षसे when the rakshasa Lavana, हते was slain, तत् that, महत् great, शूलं च trident also, सर्वदेवानाम् of all the gods, पश्यताम् as they looked on, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, वशम् into the keeping, अन्वगात् passed
entries.69.39: रघुप्रवीरः the foremost hero of the Raghus, एकेषुपातेन with the fall of a single shaft, लोकत्रयस्य अपि of all the three worlds, भृशम् mightily, निपात्य having struck him down, उत्तमचापबाणः with his excellent bow and shaft, तमः the darkness, प्रणुद्य इव as though dispelling it, सहस्ररश्मिः like the thousand-rayed sun, विनिर्बभौ shone forth
entries.69.40: ततः then, हि indeed, देवाः the gods, ऋषिपन्नगाश्च and sages and serpents, सर्वाः all, अप्सरसश्च and the apsaras, प्रपूजिरे हि did indeed do honour, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, दाशरथेः of the son of Dasharatha, जयः the victory, अवाप्तः has been won, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा having cast off, सर्पः इव like a serpent, प्रशान्तः grown calm
entries.70.1: लवणे when Lavana, हते तु had been slain, साग्निपुरोगमाः led by Agni, सेन्द्राः with Indra, देवाः the gods, शत्रुतापनम् scorcher of foes, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, सुमधुराम् a most sweet, वाणीम् speech, ऊचुः spoke
entries.70.2: वत्स O child, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, ते your, विजयः is the victory, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, लवणराक्षसः the rakshasa Lavana, हतः is slain, सुव्रत O you of good vows, वरम् a boon, वरय choose
entries.70.3: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, तुभ्यम् for you, विजयाकाङ्क्षिणः desiring victory, सर्वे एव all of us, वरदाः तु granters of boons, समागताः have come together, नः our, दर्शनम् हि appearing indeed, अमोघम् is never in vain
entries.70.4: शूरः the hero, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, प्रयतात्मवान् of disciplined soul, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, देवानाम् of the gods, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, मूर्ध्नि upon his head, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.70.5: इयम् this, मधुपुरी city of Madhu, रस्या delightful, मधुरा sweet, देवनिर्मिता fashioned by the gods, शीघ्रम् swiftly, निवेशम् a settlement, प्राप्नुयात् may it obtain, एषः this, मे my, परः highest, वरः boon, अस्तु let it be
entries.70.6: प्रीतमनसः glad at heart, देवाः the gods, तम् to him, राघवम् Raghava, बाढम् इति एव so be it indeed, रम्या delightful, शूरसेना Shurasena, पुरी the city, भविष्यति shall be, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.70.7: ते those, महात्मानः great-souled ones, तथा so, उक्त्वा having spoken, तदा then, दिवम् to heaven, आरुरुहुः ascended, महातेजाः of great splendour, शत्रुघ्नः अपि Shatrughna too, ताम् that, सेनाम् army, समुपानयत् brought up
entries.70.8: सा that, सेना army, शत्रुघ्नशासनम् the command of Shatrughna, श्रुत्वा having heard, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आगच्छत् came, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, निवेशनं च and the founding of the city, श्रावणेन in the month of Shravana, समारभत began
entries.70.9: दिव्यसङ्काशा of heavenly aspect, सा that, पुरा city, शुभे in the auspicious, द्वादशमे twelfth, वर्षे year, निविष्टा was founded, शूरसेनानाम् of the Shurasenas, विषयश्च and the realm, अकुतोभयः free of fear from any quarter
entries.70.10: क्षेत्राणि the fields, सस्ययुक्तानि rich with crops, वासवः Vasava, काले in season, वर्षति rains, शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता guarded by the arm of Shatrughna, अरोगवीरपुरुषा with its men hale and valiant
entries.70.11: अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा shaped like the half moon, यमुनातीरशोभिता gracing the bank of the Yamuna, गृहमुख्यैश्च with noble houses, चत्वरापणवीथिकैः with squares and markets and streets, शोभिता adorned, चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता peopled by all four orders, नानावाणिज्यशोभिता bright with trade of every kind
entries.70.12: पुरा formerly, तेन by him, लवणेन by Lavana, यत् what, शुभ्रम् fair, महत् great, कृतम् was made, तत् that, नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् bright with hues of every kind, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, शोभयति makes fairer still
entries.70.13: आरामैश्च with pleasure gardens, विहारैश्च and with resorts, समन्ततः on every side, शोभमानम् resplendent, शोभनीयैश्च and with things fair to see, तथा likewise, अन्यैः with others, दैवमानुषैः divine and human
entries.70.14: दिव्यसङ्काशाम् of heavenly aspect, नानापण्योपशोभिताम् bright with wares of every kind, नानादेशागतैः come from many lands, वणिग्भिः चापि and with merchants, उपशोभिताम् adorned, ताम् that, पुरीम् city
entries.70.15: समृद्धार्थः rich in substance, भरतानुजः the younger brother of Bharata, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, ताम् that, समृद्धाम् prosperous city, निरीक्ष्य having surveyed, परमप्रीतः greatly pleased, परम् the utmost, हर्षम् joy, उपागमत् came to
entries.70.16: मधुराम् the sweet, पुरीम् city, निवेश्य having founded, तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुत्पन्ना arose, द्वादश the twelfth, वर्षे year, आगते having come, अहम् I, रामपादौ the feet of Rama, निरीक्षे may look upon
entries.70.17: ततः then, रघुकुलवंशवर्धनः increaser of the line of the house of Raghu, सः that, नराधिपः lord of men, अमरपुरोपमाम् resembling the city of the immortals, विविधजनाभिसंवृताम् thronged with folk of every kind, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, निवेश्य वै having indeed founded, रघुपतिपाददर्शने upon beholding the feet of the lord of the Raghus, मतिम् his mind, दधे set
